run_create_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to convert ASE atoms files into a finetuning dataset with train and val splits
launch_processing_write_ase_db: launch parallel processing to write ASE atoms objects from input files into an ASE database
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from a training dataset subset
compute_lin_ref: compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies using least squares regression
extract_energy_and_forces: extract energy and forces from an ASE atoms object at a given dataset index
